target_customer: HR and people leaders at mid sized and large companies, especially remote first teams in India, the US and Asia Pacific
problem: Annual performance reviews and goal tracking were disconnected from daily work, so employees got feedback late and remote teams lacked a social layer for recognition.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for performance management
product_category: Performance management and OKR software for HR

founders.name: Saurabh Nangia
education: MS in machine learning, University of Illinois Urbana Champaign
founders.background_notes: YC page says he headed engineering for Snapdeal's customer experience organization and worked on Amazon's personalization team.

founders.name: Rahul Singh
founders.background_notes: Inc42 says Mesh is the third startup he built with Nangia. YC page says 12 years across tech and consulting in Europe, the Middle East and India.

founders.name: Gaurav Chaubey
founders.background_notes: Led India HR consulting at Grant Thornton with 11 years advising firms on performance management, per the YC page.

competitors.name: Workday
competitors.what: Enterprise HR suite with performance management, named by the CEO as an age old system

competitors.name: Lattice
competitors.what: Performance management startup, named by the CEO as a competitor

technical_complexity.rationale: Social feed, goal tracking and feedback app with some NLP to map feedback to company values. Standard SaaS engineering for the time.

defensibility.rationale: Performance data and review history create some lock in once adopted, but many vendors offered similar OKR and feedback features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors kept the category; Mesh itself was folded into Netchex in August 2025 per its customer notice.

market_need_then: Remote work from 2020 made continuous feedback and goal visibility more pressing; the CEO told Inc42 that old systems like Workday and Lattice did not fit remote first teams.

branding.domain_note: Uses mesh.ai; how it was obtained was not found. A different London data consultancy is also called Mesh-AI.

identity.visual_style: Social, Facebook like feed interface per the YC page
identity.voice_and_tone: AI native performance enablement per current site

branding.brand_signature: Facebook style feed where colleagues like and comment on progress

brand_strength.rationale: Generic word shared with many other Mesh brands and a separate Mesh-AI consultancy, and no press about the brand itself was found.

pivots.from: Social network for remote first companies with recognition and values scoring
pivots.to: Performance management with OKRs, reviews and 1:1s, later AI coaching
pivots.why: Inc42 in 2020 described the social network framing; later coverage describes performance management. Timing is approximate.

outcome_analysis: Serial founders with a prior exit to Snapdeal and an HR consultant co-founder raised a pre-seed in 2020, a 5 million dollar seed in 2021 and an 11 million dollar Series A in 2022. In August 2025 customer contracts were assigned to Netchex in what the notice calls a reorganisation. No sale price or shutdown cause is public, so the end state looks like a soft landing rather than a venture scale exit.
notes: The Series A article was seen as a search result title and snippet from Business Standard, Inc42 and the Mesh blog and via the YC page news line (Economic Times), not opened. The exit is typed acquisition because CB Insights describes a Netchex acquisition, but the company notice describes a transfer of operations and contracts to Netchex entities with no price. The YC directory still shows Active. Persana figures of 120 million total are ignored. The founding date was May 2020 per Inc42 in 2021 and June 2020 in 2020 coverage.
